description: Named variables of map7_s03 (Nowhere - final boss) that its Lua reads and writes with sh.map.get / sh.map.set or passes by name ("name[i]"). Each entry says where the value lives: "symbol" (an array of tables.json or a game variable shared with the engine; with "storage" too, the storage is used where the symbol is missing), "object" (the draw records of world_objects.json, starting at that object) or "storage" (a value only the scripts keep, alive for the whole run); "type" is s8/u8/s16/u16/s32/u32 (default s32) or ref (an address); "count" elements lie "stride" bytes apart from "offset". "layout" gives several names at once: vec3 (.x/.y/.z, s32 Q12 metres), svec3 (s16, Q12 turns for angles), pose (.pos, .rot) and placement (.pos). Variables every map shares are in gamedata/config/map_vars.json; this file is looked up first, and a mod patches it with its own copy. On map7_s03 (Nowhere, the final boss and the endings): ending_idx is the ending (1..4 = Good+, Good, Bad+, Bad; set when the map starts), ending_step the step every ending scene shares; boss_fx_time is the timer of the bosses' lightning and fire (0 stops them), boss_fx_mode their pattern (-1 none; map.boss_fx_mode_set also restarts the timers), boss_fx_stage the stage of the random bolts, intro_fx_stage that of the Incubus scene's timed effects, lightning_bolts_held stops random bolts (Good+), lightning_hidden hides the lightning grid; ending_dms_idx is the cutscene the ending objects follow (0 LAST12.DMS, 1 the boss's), update_* whether each ending object follows its track (HERO, ARSIA, ...) and update_nu whether NU is drawn; *_load_state are whose model the scenes loaded (0 no, 1 loading, 2 placed) and last*_dms_queued which boss cutscenes are queued; real/ura/under_world_shown the scrolling REAL, URA and UNDER worlds (ura: 2 = drawn, still); credits_vblank_clock the staff roll's frame clock; the ending scenes' voice line and the voice commands of the boss intro (Cybil's, Harry's, the Incubus's, the Incubator's) and deaths; ending_flare the glow at a fixed point (0 none, n: point n - 1); ending_effect_level the map effect level of the good endings; *_cue_step the scene step each scene's effect cues last ran at (cues with flag 2 run once per step); ending_light_target/rot where the ending light aims; bin and baby the cradle and the baby the cutscene moves (Bin and Baby objects) and bin_spin the cradle's x spin (s16 Q12 turns) that world_objects.lua steps while update_bin is set.
